messages:
alex: quick heads-up — dashboard telemetry is showing a weird spike in 'unattributed' tokens tied to recent client library churn
mira: hmm, any hypothesis? new version rollout?
alex: looks like a header/payload shape mismatch between clients. Python emits `route_policy: [\"teamA\"]`, TS/Go emit `route_policy: \"teamA\"` (string vs array)
devon: that explains it. quota attribution expects array, gateway treats string as unknown -> unattributed bucket :confused:
samir: can we make the gateway tolerant? accept both and normalize to array on ingress? then we can patch SDKs without immediate fallout
liyah: console folks — can you add a temporary mapping so historical charts don't drop? maybe tag events with `route_policy_shape:legacy` during migration so we can filter
mira: operational plan I propose:
1) deploy a gateway shim that canonicalizes both shapes to array (short lived)
2) publish SDK patches for TS/Go to emit array consistently + a runtime WARN when they detect the old shape in config
3) add migration telemetry tag and dashboard filter
4) put a deprecation note in release notes and docs
alex: canary timing? devon, can you spin up the shim in staging and do a 1-hour soak?
devon: yes, I'll push proxy-shim today and schedule a 5% canary for 2pm PT. I'll monitor `quota.unattributed` and request traces
samir: i'll open TS and Go PRs now. plan: harmless patch that serializes single-values as single-element arrays when setting route_policy. include unit tests and a compatibility test hitting the shim
liyah: console: adding the temp filter and the `route_policy_migration:2026-03` tag now, ETA 30m. also adding a one-off metric that counts shape variants by client library
alex: deploy-bot, schedule canary please
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: proxy-routepolicy-shim-canary -> 2026-03-21 14:00 PT, 5% traffic, release: r-17495-canary
devon: observing staging now. quick note: there are a few batch clients that send mixed shapes inside batched requests — shim will need to handle arrays of strings and strings inside an array — I'll add that to test matrix
mira: sdk owners — include a short migration blurb: \"No action needed for python users. TS/Go users should upgrade to vX.Y.Z to avoid warning log lines.\"
samir: ack. target SDK release next week. will coordinate changelogs and add an opt-in telemetry flag so customers can allow shape normalization logs to be sent for debugging
liyah: console side, once canary looks good we'll remove the temporary filter and rely on normalized shape. keep the migration metric for a week
alex: great. ping this thread once canary hit 50% so we can coordinate the public notes
devon: canary looks stable after 20m in staging. rolling to 50% now. watching the drop in `quota.unattributed`
liyah: saw unattributed drop ~92% in first 10m on canary traffic :tada:
mira: awesome. opening the TS/Go PRs with the migration warning text now
samir: PRs open: go#112 / ts#318. both include tests and docs. request reviews from devex and eng-platform
alex: thanks team. follow-up: create a short post in #devex announcing the change and include code snippets for migration.
